title: Preparation for E13 Embryonic Mouse Spinal Cord Cultures
author: Enock Mararo
materials: Prepare a large ice bucket with ice to keep your reagents cold.

steps.title: Prepare Dissecting Station
steps.instruction: Set up the dissecting microscope and sterilize instruments.

substeps.instruction: Clean the dissecting microscope on the bench prior to use.
Sterilize dissecting instruments and large scissors/forceps (for cervical dislocation of dam) with 70% methylated spirit (ethanol) on blue roll.

steps.title: Prepare Cold Reagents and Dishes
steps.instruction: Organize necessary reagents and dishes on ice.

substeps.instruction: Place a sterile 10 cm Petri-dish (lid on) on a small white tray next to the microscope on ice.
Place 10x trypsin (from TC freezer, room 343) on ice alongside petri dishes and bijou tubes.
Place ~ 4 ml HBSS minus Ca2+ and Mg2+ (HBSS -/-) from the cold room on ice.
Place a labeled 7 ml bijou (e.g. Star Lab E1412-0710) on ice.
Place a minimum of 2 aliquots of DNAse from the TC freezer on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Dissection Tools and Tubes
steps.instruction: Gather and label all necessary hardware for embryo processing.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 2 x sterile 35 mm Petri-dishes for dissecting embryos and removing meninges.
Prepare labeled 0.5 ml tubes if embryos/mother require genotyping.
Prepare 1 x 100 µl and 1 x 1000 µl pipettes with filter-top tips.
Prepare a sterile scalpel blade and blade handle.

steps.title: Set Up Cell Culture Hood
steps.instruction: Sterilize and equip the cell culture hood.

substeps.instruction: Turn on the hood fan and spray the hood with 70% ethanol.
Ensure the following are ready in the hood: pipettes, Pipettman, pipette tips, serological pipettes, 5 ml syringe, and one each of 21 and 23 gauge needles.

steps.title: Prepare Media and Counting Reagents
steps.instruction: Retrieve and organize media and cell counting solutions.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve 'Plating media' (PM) and 'differentiation media plus insulin' (DM+) aliquots from the fridge; place upright in 50 ml Greiner tubes in a rack at room temperature.
Retrieve pink Erythrosin B aliquots from the bottom drawer of the lab trolley for use with the haemocytometer.

steps.title: Prepare Centrifuge and Plating Dishes
steps.instruction: Label centrifuge tubes and prepare coated plating dishes.

substeps.instruction: Label 2 x 13 ml conical centrifuge tubes as 'Tube 1' and 'Tube 2' with initials; prepare a balance tube containing water and a rack.
Retrieve 35 mm Petri-dishes coated with PLL in boric acid buffer from the cold room (pink box on cell culture shelf).
Place coated dishes inside larger 10 or 25 cm Petri-dishes labeled with name, date, and experiment number.
